findings.location: Answer 8 near the bottom, long V = m/rho volume formula, at the right content edge.
findings.evidence: The mobile screenshot shows the formula only through the multiplication sign after 6.02 x 10^23. The denominator's final 3500) is visible in the already-opened desktop answer image but missing from the mobile capture. The following mobile line begins m^3 approximately 5.7 x 10^-8 m^3, so the missing denominator is not wrapped onto that line.
findings.impact: The initial mobile presentation does not expose the complete calculation, despite the page-level DOM geometry pass.
findings.repairOwnerFollowup: Repair or explicitly validate narrow-viewport presentation of the full formula so its denominator tail is available and readable. Horizontal-scroll interaction, if intended, was not exercised and cannot be approved from this screenshot. This reviewer made no repair and opened no focused capture.

limitations: Exactly eight existing images were opened once each by this reviewer. No reopens, crops, new screenshots, browser reruns or parent image opens.
Only this first whole-page batch was assessed. Existing focused viewports are a separate next batch and were not opened.
Static screenshots cannot prove horizontal-scroll affordances, keyboard/touch interaction, judging behavior, loading states, accessibility or embedded-font correctness.

Long-page images support whole composition and visible-glyph observations at their supplied resolution; per-image legibility scope is explicit and is not a substitute for focused/native-viewport certification.
